title: Information-Theoretic Pragmatics: Modeling Human Communication as a Rate-Distortion Optimization Problem

contributions.purpose: 把语用学形式化为信息论问题
contributions.mechanism: 定义语义/上下文/推理三类失真函数,建立 min I(M;U) s.t. E[d]≤D 的率失真优化模型
contributions.evaluation: 定性:纯理论无实证;给出失真函数与优化目标定义
contributions.source_quote: Formalization – We develop a mathematical model of pragmatics grounded in information theory, introducing definitions of distortion functions that capture interpretive deviations between literal and intended meaning.

contributions.purpose: 推导语用推理的一般理论性质
contributions.mechanism: 凸优化存在性证明 + 拉格朗日推出 softmax 形式最优解,证明标量含义/预设容纳/最小推理努力自然涌现
contributions.evaluation: 定性:给出存在性与最优解封闭形式,无数值验证
contributions.source_quote: Theoretical Results – We derive general properties of pragmatic inference within this framework, including conditions under which cooperative communication leads to implicature-like effects.

contributions.purpose: 把语用学接入既有数学传统
contributions.mechanism: 论证该形式化与编码论、复杂度论、贝叶斯推断的联系
contributions.evaluation: 定性:概念性桥接,无实证
contributions.source_quote: Foundational Bridge – We demonstrate how this formulation connects linguistic pragmatics with established results in coding theory, complexity theory, and Bayesian inference.

self_declared_provenance.quote: This mathematical framing allows us to recast core pragmatic effects, such as scalar implicature or context-dependent enrichment, as emergent solutions to well-defined optimization problems... extends it beyond signal transmission to the interpretation of meaning in context.

notes: 纯理论论文,自声明贡献为 threefold(Formalization/Theoretical Results/Foundational Bridge),已对应 C1-C3。非实证类适配问题:全篇无任何实验/数据,evaluation 只能定性;作者自认 limitation 是缺乏 empirical validation。checklist AI 自我披露:论文主体由 GPT-5 mini 生成(Hypothesis=D, Writing=D),人类仅监督核对;自报 AI limitation 是 LaTeX 格式与偶尔过度简化的论证。实验类 checklist 均 NA。无数据红旗(因无数据)。decision=reject。
